remarks: AVAILABLE NOW! Welcome to the light and bright 21 Betts Place #2 in East Norwalk. A COMMUTERS DREAM! One generous sized bedroom + 1 office/guest room second floor apartment including Eat In Kitchen, nicely sized living room and full bathroom. Patio in rear perfect for BBQ! Peaceful neighborhood just minutes from East Norwalk Train Station, I95 (exit 16), Veterans Park (Oyster Festival), SONO, and Calf Pasture Beach. Walk to water! BRAND NEW FULL SIZED Washer/Dryer + NEW REFRIGERATOR in unit and one assigned parking space in driveway with option to add 2nd assigned space. Plenty of street parking on Betts/Harvey/Seaview for guests/visitors. Garage storage. Landlord asking for tenants to have great credit, proof of income, and references. No pets/no smoking.
